home.aboutHeading: Welcome to the centre of bhakti-yoga in Kharkiv
home.aboutP1: In Kharkiv, on Kholodna Hora, we invite you to discover bhakti-yoga — the path of devotion where sound, community and inspiration come together.
home.aboutP2: Our temple is a home with open doors: you can join Maṅgala-ārati, sing kirtan, find stillness in a meditation circle, or simply stay in the hall for a quiet moment.
home.aboutP3: Whether it is your first visit or you already have experience — we are glad to welcome you and explore questions about mantra, vegetarian life and the Vedas together.
